checkoutflow-support: Hey team — CheckoutFlow is seeing a behavior change after yesterday's rollout. Their order-summary assistant started inserting a promotional conditional block 'Save 10% on next order!' for some orders that contain gift items. Customer says this started after the model rollout ~2024-05-05 20:45 UTC. They attached two examples and two request IDs: req_abc12345def, req_def67890ghi. Can we triage?
sara-cs: Thanks for flagging. Can you paste the exact API request bodies (redacted PII ok) and confirm the model name/version the customer pinned? Also ask for prompt logs + tenant id.
checkoutflow-support: Customer says they pinned redwood/gpt-small-1:2024-05-05, temp=0.0, top_p=1.0. They sent two redacted message arrays (pasted below). No function calling used. They claim no client-side post-processing.
mike-ml: Quick checklist: (1) request IDs + tenant, (2) exact messages array (system + user + assistant), (3) model name/version, (4) full request config (temp/top_p/max_tokens), (5) any server-side post-processing or templates. Also, were any quantization or kernel changes deployed with that artifact?
julia-runtime: Deploy log shows: redwood/gpt-small-1 -> 2024-05-05 at 20:45 UTC. I'll pull the artifact diff vs previous release. If you give me request IDs + tenant I can fetch prompt logs (logs are retained 30 days).
checkoutflow-support: Pasting minimal redacted examples from the customer (they removed order ids and emails):
--- request A (triggers promo block) ---
{"model":"redwood/gpt-small-1:2024-05-05","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a merchant order summarizer. Output JSON with keys: items, totals, notes."},{"role":"user","content":"Order: items: [{"sku":"GW-123","name":"Gift Wrap","price":2.50}], total: 2.50"}],"temperature":0.0} 
--- request B (no promo) ---
{"model":"redwood/gpt-small-1:2024-05-05","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a merchant order summarizer. Output JSON with keys: items, totals, notes."},{"role":"user","content":"Order: items: [{"sku":"REG-555","name":"Coffee Mug","price":12.00}], total: 12.00"}],"temperature":0.0} 
Customer attached request id req_ghi111222 and tenant id tenant-checkout-88 for the latest example. They assert no wrapper modifies assistant outputs.
tom-support: If prompts show the system message is clean, then likely either a model behavior shift or an upstream template applied by the customer. We should check tokenization around SKU 'GW-123' and whether a cached prefix or KV cache fallback introduced a stale policy. @mike-ml can you repro locally with the exact messages?
mike-ml: I'll reproduce locally with the artifact 2024-05-05 and the previous artifact 2024-05-04 with identical request bodies. Also checking whether any new prompt-conditioning rule was baked into system prompt during model build. Can someone grant me access to the prompt logs?
julia-runtime: I have a log pointer: s3://private-logs/tenant-checkout-88/req_ghi111222/prompt_log_redacted.json — I'll DM a secure link (we redact emails/cc numbers). Notifying @eng-security.
eng-security: Confirmed DM share allowed; ensure PII redaction. If customer consents, we can pull full headers for debugging.
sara-cs: To be explicit, ask the customer for: 1) minimal repro (one request that triggers, one that doesn't) exactly as sent to the API; 2) request IDs and tenant id (they provided); 3) permission to access prompt logs (they gave consent); 4) clarify there is no client-side template/tail provided. If we can repro we classify P0.
checkoutflow-support: Customer uploaded the two minimal repro bodies and consented to redwood pulling logs. They also confirm they used no post-processing and that the assistant output had the extra promo block in plain text, not as part of a JSON notes field.
mike-ml: Reproduced locally with the 2024-05-05 artifact — when the 'Gift Wrap' SKU tokenizes into a token sequence ["gift", "wrap"] plus a BPE suffix, we see the model sometimes switch to a short marketing completion when 'notes' follows an items list. This smells like a subtle prefix-attention change in the 2024-05-05 kernel selection path. I'll run a targeted trace and diff attention weights for the tokens around the SKU.
julia-runtime: I've queued a canary rollback for the artifact if we confirm regression. Deploy-bot: Deploy completed: redwood/gpt-small-1 -> 2024-05-05 at 20:45 UTC by julia-runtime :rocket: (noted for audit).
eng-security: Keep communications on the DM for logs. We'll only surface redacted examples in the public ticket.
sara-cs: Great progress — please post repro steps and ETA. If reproducible, we will notify CheckoutFlow with timeline (aiming for rollback within 4h or model patch).
mike-ml: Will post a minimal repro script (curl + messages array) and my local diff within 90 minutes.
checkoutflow-support: Customer thanks the team and will stand by for updates. They also supplied one more request id req_jkl333444 for a different order that also shows the promo block.
sara-cs: Closing loop: we have everything needed to triage — moving to P0, assigned to @mike-ml (ML) and @julia-runtime (runtime). Will follow up in this thread with results. :eyes:
